sections.A: Takhne ke bahar teen ligaments hain (ATFL, CFL, PTFL). Pair andar mudne se sab se pehle ATFL zakhmi hota hai.
sections.B: Pair mudna, kabhi pop, phir takhne ke bahar dard aur sujan, aur chalne mein mushkil.
sections.C: Pair kis taraf muda, kya chal sake, aur kya pehle bhi moch aayi.
sections.D: Sujan, neel aur wazan uthana dekhein. Ligaments test karne se pehle fracture ka rule lagayein.
sections.E: Ottawa ankle rules batate hain ke X-ray chahiye ya nahi. Phir anterior drawer aur talar tilt se ligaments check karein (kuch din baad zyada accurate).
sections.F: Fracture, syndesmosis (high ankle) injury aur peroneal tendon ki chot isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Ottawa positive, kharabi ya shadeed dard (fracture), ya peela thanda pair: urgent ya emergency refer.
sections.H: Red flags, phir Ottawa rules. Negative ho to lateral ankle sprain, aur syndesmosis ko alag pehchanein.
sections.I: Dorsiflexion ke liye mobilisation with movement aur joint mobilisation.
sections.J: Jaldi functional ilaaj: brace ya tape se hifazat, jaldi wazan aur movement, phir balance aur taaqat taa ke moch dobara na aaye.
sections.L: Pehle din Ottawa screen, hifazat, sujan kam karna aur halki movement. Phir balance, taaqat aur khel par wapsi.
sections.M: Dard, sujan, knee-to-wall dorsiflexion, taaqat, balance aur hop tests dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 22 saal ka basketball player 5 din pehle takhna mod baitha. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: Ottawa rules, hifazat aur jaldi dheere dheere load.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
